name: Lozoyuela-Navas-Sieteiglesias (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, blue above and green below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lozoyuela-Navas-Sieteiglesias (a tree, a deer and a bridge on red and white).
history: Municipal flag of Lozoyuela-Navas-Sieteiglesias; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Lozoyuela-Navas-Sieteiglesias arms — tree, deer and bridge on red and white
